title: Q-PILOT-application-intake: Pilot application intake that records applications as data
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::pilotApplication
**Status:** open

The /pilot page states the program from doctrine/pilot-model.json. Add POST /api/pilot that validates the five apply_fields, stores the application (KV, no personal data beyond a contact the applicant supplies), scores it against the selection criteria and files a review item, so an application is never an email nobody reads.
